name: Berkshires Cube Day at BART 2026

venue.name: Berkshire Arts & Technology Charter Public School
venue.details: Competition will be in the gym and cafeteria.

Cubing returns to the Berkshires for the first time in nearly a decade! 

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.

### **Students at the BART school can register for free. Please see the extra registration requirements for further info.**
